name: How much does it cost to build a new home?
description: New home construction costs vary widely, typically ranging from $200 to $400 per square foot, depending on design and materials.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a new home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a new home is highly variable and depends on numerous factors, including the home's size, architectural style, materials chosen, interior finishes, and site preparation needs. Custom homes typically range from $200 to $400 per square foot, but this can be higher for luxury finishes or complex designs. Additional costs may include permits, land acquisition, landscaping, and utility connections. A detailed estimate will be provided after understanding your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: New home construction costs vary widely, typically ranging from $200 to $400 per square foot, depending on design and materials.
